caseNameFull: Arthur J. Robertoy v. State of Michigan
attorneys: Petitioner pro se., Paul L. Adams, Attorney General of Michigan, and Samuel J. Torina, Solicitor General, for respondent.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The appeal is dismissed for the reason that the judgment of the Supreme Court of Michigan, sought here to be reviewed, is based upon a nonfederal ground adequate to support it.
